title: Israeli forces raid Kamal Adwan Hospital in northern Gaza
body:
On Friday 25 October 2024, the Gaza health ministry accused Israeli forces of storming Kamal Adwan Hospital, which it described as the last functioning hospital in northern Gaza. The ministry said two children died in the intensive care unit after generators failed and an oxygen station was targeted, that forces were searching the building and firing inside departments, and that they detained hundreds of patients, medical staff and displaced people.

The Israeli military said its forces were operating around the hospital in the Jabalia refugee camp area, where it had launched a major operation earlier that month, and said it was not aware of live fire and strikes in the area of the hospital. Israel said it allowed 23 patients to be transferred out on Thursday night, which the World Health Organization confirmed. Israel has said its aim is to destroy Hamas capabilities it says are being rebuilt in the north, and accuses Hamas of operating from hospitals, which Hamas denies.

The WHO said it lost contact with hospital staff on Friday morning, and its chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called the situation deeply disturbing. UN human rights chief Volker Türk described it as the darkest moment in northern Gaza and said more than 150,000 people were reportedly dead, wounded or missing. The Gaza health ministry reported 42,847 people killed since the war began.
